findings.reason: The original standalone tile and frozen/current source contain no diagram. A data-flow schematic materially clarifies that neighbor aggregation excludes the current vertex while its previous state is a separate update input, and that graph-wide multiset readout occurs only at the end. This is an authorized explanatory-diagram addition, not an error in the existing mathematical definition.
findings.action: Added a final Remarks section with a two-row TikZ diagram for one local layer and final graph readout; included multiplicity, shared-map, K=0 and arrow-convention explanations.

correction: Added an explanatory neighborhood aggregation/update and final graph readout schematic without changing any original carrier bytes.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Fix v in V and 1 <= k <= K. Neighbor states lie in H_(k-1), their finite multiset lies in M_fin(H_(k-1)), and a_v^k lies in Z_k.
diagram_math_checks.relations: The A_k arrow takes precisely the multiset indexed by N_G(v) to a_v^k.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Definition paragraph at source line 34 gives A_k: M_fin(H_(k-1)) -> Z_k; displayed recursion at line 37 gives this exact value. def-finite-labeled-graph defines N_G(v) using two-element edges, hence excludes v. def-multiset preserves repeated equal values.

diagram_math_checks.objects: The U_k box receives the previous vertex state h_v^(k-1) in H_(k-1) from above and the aggregate a_v^k in Z_k from the left; it outputs h_v^k in H_k.
diagram_math_checks.relations: Two incoming data-flow arrows express U_k(h_v^(k-1),a_v^k)=h_v^k, with the ordered argument meaning supplied by the unchanged displayed recursion. These arrows do not orient edges of G and assert no commutativity or injectivity.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Definition lines 34 and 37 specify the domain H_(k-1) x Z_k, codomain H_k and update equality. No vertex identity or global input is introduced.

diagram_math_checks.objects: The bottom row collects final node states into a finite multiset in M_fin(H_K) and outputs z_G in Y.
diagram_math_checks.relations: R({{h_w^K:w in V}})=z_G. The bound index w is merely renamed from v to distinguish it from the fixed vertex in the first row.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Definition line 40 states the same readout with domain M_fin(H_K), codomain Y. Caption limits readout to completion of K layers, preserves shared maps, and explicitly handles K=0. The mathematical definition and its justification remain independent of the figure; there is no supplied proof to alter.
